Scholarships and grants for graduate students

Share :
Facebook Linked in Print

Whether you are a French or international student and whatever your study program is (master's, PhD tracks etc.), financial support is available for you.  

Here you’ll find useful information about three types of financial aids designed for different kinds of study projects and students from low-income families:

  • Scholarships
  • Mobility grants
  • Social criteria grants
SCHOLARSHIPS
MOBILITY GRANTS
SOCIAL CRITERIA GRANTS

Scholarships for graduate students vary depending on one’s school, degree programs, and specific enrollment status.
Listed below are five types of scholarships provided or co-funded by Université PSL and its member schools and fellowships offered by the French government. They are open for the academic year 2024-2025. Please refer to the link of each scholarship for updated details and contact information.

1) Université PSL Graduate Programs Excellence Grants

Several PSL Graduate Programs award scholarships to M1 or/and M2 students based on their excellent academic performance, motivation and (in some cases) financial situation.

Some scholarships are open for specific tracks and levels of study. Please refer to the graduate program’s web page or contact the head of the program for detailed information

 

Excellence Grants in Chemistry

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree programs:

Master’s of Chemistry

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Chemistry

Excellence Grants in Engineering (ISAI)

Eligibility: International students

Applicable PSL degree programs:

Master’s programs in:

  • Energy
  • Materials Science and Engineering
  • BioMedical Engineering Paris
  • Nuclear Energy

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Engineering (ISAI)

Excellence Grants in Computer Science

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree programs: Master’s in Computer Science

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Computer Science

See detailed information about the excellence grants in Computer Science

Excellence Grants in Mathematics

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree programs: Master’s in Mathematics and Applications

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Mathematics and Application

Excellence Grants in Finance

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree programs: Master’s in Finance (Research in Finance track)

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Finance

See detailed information about the excellence grants in Finance

Excellence Grants in Earth and Biodiversity Sciences

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree programs: Master’s in Earth and Planetary Science, Environment

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Earth and Biodiversity Sciences

Excellence Grants in Life Sciences

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree programs: Master’s in Life Sciences (only students enrolled in IMaGHE- Integrative PhysioPathology curriculum who carry out an internship in a PSL laboratory can apply for the excellence grant)

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Life Sciences

See detailed information about the excellence grants in Life Sciences

 

Excellence Grants in Religious Studies

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree programs:

Master’s programs in:

  • Civilizations, Culture and Society
  • Asian Studies
  • Philosophy
  • Religious Sciences and Societies

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Religious Studies

Email: pg.ephe@ephe.psl.eu

Excellence Scholarship in Management

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree programs:

2nd year of the Master’s in:

  • Research and Consulting in Strategic Management
  • Business Consulting and Digital Organization
  • Marketing Research and Consulting
  • Consulting and Research in Audit and Control
  • Sustainable Development and Organizational Responsibility
  • Network Industries and the Digital Economy
  • Fashion & Materials
  • Institutions, Economics and Society (Research in socioeconomics)

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Management

See detailed information about the excellence grants in Management

Excellence Scholarship in Physics

Eligibility: International students

Applicable PSL degree programs:

Master’s programs in:

  • Physics (ICFP)

Funded by: PSL Graduate Program in Physics

2) Université PSL PhD Tracks grants

Université PSL offers 5-year fully funded programs from Master’s to Doctorate level covering seven research fields.

 

PhD Tracks

Eligibility: All nationalities

Fields of study:

  • Chemistry
  • Life Sciences
  • Engineering
  • Computer sciences
  • Astrophysics
  • Earth sciences & biodiversity
  • Physics
  • Cognitive sciences

Application Process: Awarded at Admission

PSL PhD tracks

3) Fellowships funded by Université PSL’s member schools

Several schools provide scholarships for specific fields of study and master’s programs.

 

International Selection (ENS-PSL)

Eligibility: International students

Applicable PSL degree programs: Master’s programs in Sciences and Arts & Humanities at ENS-PSL. Students selected by international selection must enroll in the DENS (ENS graduate Degree).

Funded by: Ecole normale supérieure (ENS)-PSL

Qlife Master Scholarship

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree program: Master’s in Life Sciences (IMaLis)

Application Process: By individual application

Funded by: Ecole normale supérieure (ENS)-PSL

Merit-Based Scholarships for Non-EU Students (Dauphine-PSL)

Eligibility: Non-EU Students

Applicable PSL degree programs/schools: Non-EU Students (whose tax residence is outside the European Economic Area) enrolled in a grand établissement degree (DGE) program with a flexible fee structure at Dauphine-PSL. The scholarship can only be used for a partial (50%) or total tuition exemption in the second year of the Master’s program.

Funded by: Dauphine-Paris

List of Master’s degrees known as DGE: click here

Excellence Scholarship (MINES Paris-PSL)

Eligibility: International students

Applicable PSL degree programs/schools: Engineering degree at MINES Paris-PSL

Funded by: Mines-Paris Fondation

Email: international@mines-paristech.fr 

Scholarship for Master’s Program in Public Policy and Development (PPD)

Eligibility: International students of the PPD Master's program from a middle/ low-income country

Applicable PSL degree program: Master’s in Public Policy and Development (Applied Economics)

Funded by: Paris School of Economics (PSE)/Ecoles Universitaires de Recherche (EUR)

See also PSE's "Funding Opportunities for Foreign Students" booklet 

 

Excellence Scholarship (ESPCI-PSL)

Eligibility: International students

Applicable PSL degree programs/schools: Priority is given to students applying for a double engineering degree at ESPCI-PSL

Funded by: ESPCI foundation

Email: international@espci.psl.eu

4) Scholarships co-funded by Université PSL

 

Paris Mathematical Sciences Foundation (FSMP) Scholarship

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree program: Master’s in Mathematics

Funded by: Paris Mathematical Sciences Foundation

Paris Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (PRAIRIE) Merit Scholarship

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL degree program: 

The PRAIRIE Institute offers scholarships to students who want to enroll in a Master's program with an AI curriculum. The applicable programs are:

  • Master IASD (Artificial Intelligence, Systems, Data science)
  • Master's in Mathematics and Applications
  • Master's in Computer Science

Funded by: Paris Artificial Intelligence Research Institute

5) Government scholarships

French government scholarships are granted by the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs. Most scholarships are awarded by the Cooperation and Cultural Action Departments (SCACs) in French embassies and consulates general abroad. Applicants should directly contact the SCAC in their country of origin for information about available scholarships, eligibility, and selection procedures.

The French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs also awards scholarships under specific programs as listed below

 

Excellence-Major Scholarship

Eligibility: International students in their final year of a French high school abroad recognized and accredited by the French Ministry of National Education (see the list)

Applicable PSL degree programs/ schools: All PSL bachelor’s programs

Application Process: By nomination. Interested students must contact their high school for the preselection.

Funded by: The French Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the AEFE (Agence Française pour l’Enseignement Français à l’Etranger)

France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship

Eligibility:

International students aged:

  • 25 years old or under for Master candidate
  • 30 years old or under for PhD candidate

Applicable PSL degree programs/ schools: Some of PSL’s member schools accept and support applications for the Eiffel Scholarship (see the list below). Not all fields of study and degree programs are eligible. Please refer to the web page of each school for detailed information.  

Application Process: By nomination. French higher education institutions preselect candidates and then submit applications via Campus France. The preselection procedures usually take place around October/November. Please contact the International Relations Office of the host school of the program you wish to apply.

France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Program 

List of PSL's member schools that present candidates for the Eiffel Scholarship and their contact email :

  • Dauphine-PSL (accompagnement.etudiant@dauphine.psl.eu)
  • Mines-Paris (international@mines-paristech.fr)
  • ESPCI-PSL (international@espci.psl.eu)
  • Chimie-Paris (international@chimieparistech.psl.eu)
  • EPHE (dri@ephe.psl.eu)
  • Observatoire de Paris (international.ufe@obspm.fr)
France Excellence Europa Scholarship

Eligibility: EU Students

Applicable PSL degree programs/ schools:

First year or second year of a Master’s program in the following study fields:

  • Culture & Heritage
  • Education
  • Pedagogy
  • French Language and Civilization
  • Foreign Languages and Civilizations and European Studies
  • Law and political science
  • Health
  • Environmental Sciences
  • Computer Science and Digital

Application Process: By nomination. Interested students must contact the French embassy in their home country for the preselection.

France Excellence Europa Scholarship Program

 

PSL's member schools, the European Commission, the French government, and regional authorities provide different kinds of outgoing mobility grants to increase students' international competitiveness. Several PSL's schools also offer incoming mobility grants for international students who come to pursue their studies in France.

 

Erasmus Mobility Grants (Mobility in Europe)

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs: PSL’s schools are members of the Erasmus+ program and support students who plan to study in one of the European member states in the Erasmus+ program.
Please contact the International Relations Office of your school for further information.  

Funded by: European Commission

Erasmus+AMI grants (International mobility)

Eligibility: CROUS social criteria grants holders

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs:

The AMI grant allows students to study abroad in an exchange program or to carry out an international internship. It can be cumulated with the Erasmus+ Mobility Grant. Please get in touch with the International Relations Office of your school for further information.

Funded by: Ministry of Higher Education and Research

Mobility Grants from the Region Ile-de-France

Eligibility: Students with a total gross income of the tax household inferior to 19 1910 €

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs:

Eligible schools:

  • Dauphine-PSL  
  • Ecole Nationale des Chartes-PSL
  • Ecoles normale supérieure (ENS)-PSL
  • Ecole de Chimie-PSL
  • Ecole Pratique des Hautes Etudes (EPHE)-PSL
  • ESPCI-PSL
  • MINES Paris-PSL

Please contact the International Relations Office of the above-mentioned schools for further information.

Funded by: Regional Council of Ile-de-France

Offical website of Region Ile-de-France

Dauphine Foundation Scholarship (International mobility)

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs:

Students enrolled in the following levels at Dauphine-PSL:

  • Bachelor's 3rd year
  • Master’s level

Funded by: Dauphine-PSL

Mobility Grants from Observatoire de Paris-PSL

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs: Observatoire de Paris-PSL offers its students several outgoing and incoming mobility grants. Please refer to the link below for further information.

Funded by: Observatoire de Paris-PSL

Mobility Grants from EPHE-PSL

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs: EPHE-PSL offers its students several outgoing and incoming mobility grants. Please refer to the grants directory below or contact their International Relations Office for further information.

Funded by: EPHE-PSL

Email: dri@ephe.psl.eu

Mobility Grants from ESPCI-PSL

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs: ESPCI-PSL offers its students several outgoing mobility grants. Please refer to the link below for further information.

Funded by: ESPCI-Paris

Outgoing mobility

Email: international@espci.psl.eu

Mobility Grants from Chimie Paris-PSL

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs: Chime Paris-PSL offers its students several mobility grants. Please have a look at the link below for more information or contact their International Relations Office.

Funded by: Chime Paris-PSL

Email: international@chimieparistech.psl.eu

Mobility Grants from PSL Graduate Programs in Historical Sciences and Religious Studies

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs:

The mobility grants support students in the first and second year of their Master’s who plan to study or carry out an internship in France or abroad. Student enrolled in the following Master’s programs are eligible:

  • Civilizations, Culture and Society
  • Asian Studies
  • Art History and Archeology
  • Religious Studies and Society

For detailed information please contact the head of graduate programs concerned.

Funded by: PSL Graduate Programs in Historical Sciences/ Religious Studies

Mobility Grants from PSL Graduate Programs in Earth and Biodiversity Sciences

Eligibility: All nationalities

Applicable PSL Schools/ degree programs: The mobility grants support students enrolled in the first and second year of the Master’s in Life Sciences who plan to study or carry out an internship in France or abroad. For detailed information please contact the head of graduate program.

Funded by: PSL Graduate Programs In Earth and Biodiversity Sciences

CROUS Social Criteria Grants

Eligibility:

  • French students under the age of 28 years old.
  • EU and Non-EU students must meet other conditions to be eligible for the CROUS social criteria grant. Please refer to the link below for detailed information.

Funded by: French Ministry of Higher Education and Research

Joliot Grants (ESPCI-PSL)

Eligibility: The Joliot scholarships are open to French and foreign engineering students. It can be granted as a complement to other financial aids obtained by the applicants.

Funded by: ESPCI-PSL

Social aids from EPHE-PSL

Eligibility: Students of all nationalities enrolled in EPHE-PSL

Funded by: EPHE-PSL
